audit.whatIsWrong: The coverage packet records that not one Fiora ability is named anywhere in this matchup, and the Riposte interaction is stated as vaguely as 'if she stuns your W-stun the trade flips'.
audit.why: Riot's Riposte text is precise and it is the whole matchup: she 'parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.' Shield Vault's stun is an immobilizing effect, so opening with W does not merely get blocked — it upgrades her counter from a slow into a stun. And it is 24 seconds at rank 1, the longest cooldown in the lane.
audit.corrected: Never open with Shield Vault into an up Riposte: blocking your stun is what turns her stab into a stun. Bait its 24s with a tap-Q first.

audit.whatIsWrong: Duelist's Dance is described only as 'her passive vitals' and its heal is never mentioned; Lunge's on-hit application is absent too.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: 'If she hits the Vital, she restores Health and gains Move Speed.' Riot's Lunge text: it stabs 'applying on-hit effects'. Both are flagged in _missing-interactions.json — the heal is why Grievous Wounds matters, and the on-hit is why reading her damage as pure AD and answering with armour misprices the trade.
audit.corrected: Vitals heal her on every proc, and Lunge carries on-hit effects — anti-heal earns its slot and armour alone reads the trade wrong.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, so 'bait her parry' has no timer attached to it.
audit.why: Riposte 24/22/20/18/16, Lunge 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6, Bladework 11/10/9/8/7, Grand Challenge 110/90/70. Riposte's 24s against Shield Vault's 13s means a baited Riposte hands you two clean gap-closes — that is the entire early game plan and it was unquantified.
audit.corrected: Riposte's 24s now anchors the spikes, the cooldown block, the dos and the interactions row.

audit.why: 49.48% over 966 games with the chart giving Pantheon levels 2-3 and both item stages, Fiora levels 1, 4-5 and 6 — the shape is right even if the item rows read generously. Early lane is Pantheon's, the side-lane duel is Fiora's, and Pantheon's real value at 6 is the Grand Starfall roam.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are entirely yours and you must use them. At level 1 your point-and-click W stun does serious damage before her passive vitals matter, so look for an early W-Q tap trade. The trap is her W parry — if she stuns your W-stun the trade flips, so bait it onto your E block channel or a throwaway tap-Q first, then commit the real W-stun. At level 3 with E added you have your premier kill window: E into her Q dash, W-stun, empowered-Q.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are entirely yours and you must use them. At level 1 Shield Vault's leap-stun does serious damage before Duelist's Dance vitals matter, so look for the early W-Q tap. The trap is Riposte: it parries all incoming damage, and blocking an immobilizing effect is exactly what upgrades her stab from a slow into a stun — so never open with W. Bait its 24 seconds with a tap-Q, then commit. Level 3 is your premier kill window.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 your raw kill pressure dips as she stabilizes and starts threatening vital procs. Keep poking with the long-thrown empowered-Q and use E to block her Q-dash harass, but respect that every melee trade now feeds her passive true damage. Your level 6 is for Grand Starfall roams, not a 1v1 widen — leave the lane and convert your early lead on other maps rather than forcing a duel she's catching up in.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 your kill pressure dips as Lunge comes down toward 6 seconds and she starts hunting vitals. Keep poking with the thrown empowered Comet Spear and face her so Aegis Assault eats the Lunge, but respect that every melee trade heals her on each vital she hits. Level 6 is for Grand Starfall roams, not a 1v1 widen — convert the early lead elsewhere rather than force a duel she is catching up in.

edits.before: Your point-and-click W stun is one of the strongest level-1 hits in the game and her vitals aren't online yet — take the W-Q trade.
edits.after: Shield Vault's leap-stun is one of the strongest level-1 hits in the game and Riposte is not ranked yet — take the W-Q trade.

edits.after: Level 3 is your premier kill window: face the Lunge, W-stun, empowered-Q, all before Riposte's 24s can punish it.

notes: The page claimed Fiora's vitals 'deal percent-max-HP true damage that ignores your shields'. Riot's Duelist's Dance text in the kit file says only that hitting a Vital restores health and grants move speed — the true-damage flag sits on Grand Challenge, not the passive. Rather than assert or deny the percent-HP true damage, I replaced that clause with the two properties Riot's text does state (the heal, and Lunge's on-hit application), both of which change how you build. The true-damage question is logged in unverified.
